name: keep-terminal
description: Restore your terminals (names and working directories) when a VS Code workspace is reopened.

commands.title: Keep Terminal: Apply Recommended Built-in Terminal Settings

keepTerminal.autoRestore.description: On startup, recreate saved terminals that VS Code did not restore itself.

keepTerminal.suggestBuiltinSettings.description: On startup, offer to configure VS Code's built-in terminal persistence, which also restores split layout, colors and icons.

keepTerminal.restoreDelayMs.description: How long no new terminal must appear on startup before restoring, so VS Code's own terminal revive finishes first.
